Class LessonsLearned

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.LessonsLearned
public class LessonsLearned extends Object

Title: LessonsLearned Class

Description: This LessonsLearned class represents one lesson learned in the system. It contains the lesson's core information (title, category, situation, and lesson text), the unique ID assigned by the database, the username of the contributor who owns it, and the curator-controlled state that the Contributor user stories require the contributor to see: whether the whole lesson or individual fields are locked, and whether a curator has edited the lesson.

Attribute sources and rationale:

Persistent Contributor attributes
AttributesSource and rationale
lessonIdContributor stories 1/2: stable identity for managing a selected lesson.
ownerUserId, ownerStories 1/4: immutable account ID authorizes reads/writes; owner is the current display name. Renaming or reusing a name never transfers ownership.
title, category, situation, lessonTextStory 1 core information, concretized by the team's HW2 fields: identify, organize, describe context, and explain the reusable lesson.
CATEGORIESHW2 design policy: one vocabulary shared by GUI and validation.
LOCKABLE_FIELDSStory 2 and TP3 curator locking epic: canonical names for per-field locks.
lessonLockedStory 2: a whole-lesson lock prevents Contributor edits and deletion.
titleLocked, categoryLocked, situationLocked, lessonTextLockedStory 2: protect selected fields while allowing other edits; any lock prevents lesson deletion.
curatorEditedStory 4: retain original authorship and identify curator-edited content.
createdAt, updatedAtTeam persistence/audit design and future curator work: database-controlled creation and last-change times. Legacy rows use migration time.

Experience attempts and member effort are linked through LessonExperience. Private curator notes, search terms and aggregate-summary capacity are stored separately so Contributor projections cannot disclose them. These accommodate published TP3 directions; team-specific epic allocations still require confirmation.

    • CATEGORIES

      public static final String[] CATEGORIES
      The categories a lesson may be assigned to. The GUI uses this list to populate its category selector and the recognizer uses it to reject any other value, so both always agree on the allowed categories.

    • LOCKABLE_FIELDS

      public static final String[] LOCKABLE_FIELDS
      The names of the fields a curator can lock individually. These are the same names the LessonRecognizer reports in lessonRecognizerErrorField, so the GUI can use one name to find both a field's validation error and its lock state.

    • LessonsLearned

      public LessonsLearned()

    • LessonsLearned

      public LessonsLearned(String owner, String title, String category, String situation, String lessonText)

      Method: LessonsLearned(String owner, String title, String category, String situation, String lessonText)

      Description: This constructor is used to establish a new lesson that has not yet been stored in the database. The lesson ID is set to 0 because the database assigns the real ID when the lesson is added. A new lesson has no locks and has not been edited by a curator.

      Parameters:
      owner - specifies the username of the contributor adding the lesson
      title - specifies the lesson's title
      category - specifies the lesson's category (one of CATEGORIES)
      situation - specifies what happened that led to the lesson
      lessonText - specifies what was learned

    • LessonsLearned

      public LessonsLearned(int lessonId, String owner, String title, String category, String situation, String lessonText)

      Method: LessonsLearned(int lessonId, String owner, String title, String category, String situation, String lessonText)

      Description: This constructor is used to rebuild a lesson that was read from the database, so it includes the ID the database assigned. The lock and curator-edited flags are set afterward with their setters, which keeps this constructor the same shape as the one used for new lessons.

      Parameters:
      lessonId - specifies the unique ID assigned by the database
      owner - specifies the username of the contributor who added the lesson
      title - specifies the lesson's title
      category - specifies the lesson's category (one of CATEGORIES)
      situation - specifies what happened that led to the lesson
      lessonText - specifies what was learned

    • isFieldLocked

      public boolean isFieldLocked(String fieldName)

      Method: boolean isFieldLocked(String fieldName)

      Description: Reports whether the named field cannot be edited by the contributor. A field is uneditable when it is locked itself or when the whole lesson is locked, so the GUI can ask one question per field instead of checking both flags.

      Parameters:
      fieldName - is one of LOCKABLE_FIELDS ("Title", "Category", "Situation", "Lesson")
      Returns:
      true if the field cannot be edited; false for an unknown field name
